# Results


From
`r format(lubridate::floor_date(study_period[1L], "month"), "%B %Y")`
to
`r format(lubridate::floor_date(study_period[2L], "month"), "%B %Y")`,
a total of `r n_agcs["initial"]` canisters were deployed
of which
`r n_agcs["final"]` were selected for desorption
(Figure\ \@ref(fig:agc-flowchart)).
These canisters were in place during `r n_cases["final"]` anaesthesia cases,
of which `r n_cases_inhalational` used inhalational anaesthesia
(Table\ \@ref(tab:table-one)).
The remaining `r n_cases["final"] - n_cases_inhalational` cases were performed
under TIVA with the canister still connected.
Entries were missing for the start time in `r sum(is.na(final_crf$start))` cases,
the end time in `r sum(is.na(final_crf$end))`,
the fresh gas flow in `r sum(is.na(final_crf$flow))`
and the airway device in `r sum(is.na(final_crf$airway))`.
In total, `r sum(is.na(final_crf$airway) | is.na(final_crf$laparoscopic) | is.na(final_crf$inhalational.anaesthesia))` cases
could not be assigned to one of the `r length(clustering_columns) - 1L` subgroup variables.

Desorption of all analysed canisters was performed on
`r sub("^0", "", format(zeosys_desorption_date, "%d %B %Y"))`.
ZeoSys recovered
`r zeosys_sevo_weight_kg` kg (`r zeosys_sevo_volume_l` L)
of sevoflurane and reported
that sevoflurane accounted for
`r round(zeosys_yield * 100, 1)`%
of the canisters’ weight gain.
The remaining `r round((1 - zeosys_yield) * 100, 1)`%
was water, with traces of degradation products (Compounds A to E)
and patient-derived volatiles such as acetone.
The `r n_agcs["final"]` analysed canisters accounted for an estimated
`r round(n_bottles["final"], 1)` bottles
(`r round(sevo_final_kg, 1)` kg).
Relative to this subset, the recovered `r zeosys_sevo_weight_kg` kg
corresponded to a capture efficiency of `r round(recovery_pct_final, 1)`%.
Pre-desorption weights were taken `r zeosys_days_weight1_to_desorption` and `r zeosys_days_weight2_to_desorption` days before desorption.
During this storage period,
the `r sum(!is.na(final_wdiff))` canisters weighed on both occasions
lost a median of `r round(abs(zeosys_med_wdiff_g), 1)` g
(`r round(zeosys_wdiff_pct_of_gain, 1)`% of the median weight gain).
This corresponds to a total storage loss of `r round(zeosys_total_wloss_g, 0)` g.
Figure\ \@ref(fig:weight-gain-stripplot-by-centre) shows the distribution of weight gain per canister and participating centre.

```{r agc-flowchart, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, fig.cap = "Flow diagram of anaesthetic gas canisters from study sites to analysis. AGC, anaesthetic gas canister; OR, operating room."}
library("consort")

count_ors <- function(ids) length(unique(agcs$or[agcs$agc.id %in% ids]))
count_ctr <- function(ids) length(unique(agcs$center[agcs$agc.id %in% ids]))
fmt       <- function(ids) paste0("n = ", length(ids), "; ", count_ors(ids), " ORs; ",
                                  count_ctr(ids), " centres")
excl      <- function(reason)
    agcs$agc.id[!is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason) & agcs$exclusion.reason == reason]

all_ids   <- agcs$agc.id
excl1_ids <- excl("poor documentation")
excl2_ids <- excl("less than 10 cases")
excl3_ids <- excl("lost")
excl4_ids <- excl("outlier")
step1_ids <- agcs$agc.id[agcs$exclusion.reason %in% c("outlier") |
                          is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)]
final_ids <- agcs$agc.id[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)]

p <- add_box(txt = paste0("AGCs used\n", fmt(all_ids)))
p <- add_side_box(p, side = "right", txt = paste0(
    "Excluded (n = ", length(c(excl1_ids, excl2_ids, excl3_ids)), ")",
    "\n- Poor documentation (n = ", length(excl1_ids), ")",
    "\n- Less than 10 cases (n = ", length(excl2_ids), ")",
    "\n- Not available at ZeoSys (n = ", length(excl3_ids), ")"
))
p <- add_box(p, txt = paste0("AGCs eligible\n", fmt(step1_ids)))
p <- add_side_box(p, side = "right", txt = paste0(
    "Not selected (n = ", length(excl4_ids), ")"
))
p <- add_box(p, txt = paste0("AGCs selected for desorption\n", fmt(final_ids)))

p <- add_label_box(p, txt = c("1" = "Study sites", "2" = "ZeoSys", "3" = "Analysis"))

plot(p, grViz = !is_docx_output())
```

```{r table-one, echo = FALSE}
t1_data <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]

## derived per-canister variables
n_inha_cols       <- grep("^n\\.cases.*inha", names(t1_data), value = TRUE)
n_tiva_cols       <- grep("^n\\.cases.*tiva", names(t1_data), value = TRUE)
t1_data$pct.ba    <- rowSums(t1_data[, n_inha_cols, drop = FALSE]) /
                     t1_data$n.cases * 100
t1_data$pct.tiva2 <- rowSums(t1_data[, n_tiva_cols, drop = FALSE]) /
                     t1_data$n.cases * 100
t1_data$pct.tube2 <- t1_data$pct.tube * 100
t1_data$pct.lap2  <- t1_data$pct.lap  * 100

## formatting helpers
med_iqr <- function(x, d = 1, min_n = 5L) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    if (!length(x)) return("—")
    if (length(x) < min_n)
        return(formatC(median(x), digits = d, format = "f"))
    sprintf("%s [%s–%s]",
            formatC(median(x),         digits = d, format = "f"),
            formatC(quantile(x, 0.25), digits = d, format = "f"),
            formatC(quantile(x, 0.75), digits = d, format = "f"))
}
n_pct <- function(x) {
    n   <- sum(x == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)
    tot <- sum(!is.na(x))
    sprintf("%d (%d%%)", n, round(n / tot * 100))
}

## build one column per group
centres  <- sort(unique(t1_data$center))
grp_dfs  <- c(
    list(Overall = t1_data),
    setNames(lapply(centres, function(ctr) t1_data[t1_data$center == ctr, ]),
             paste("Centre", centres))
)

make_col <- function(df) c(
    paste0("n = ", nrow(df)),
    med_iqr(df$n.cases,      d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$pct.ba,       d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$pct.tiva2,    d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$sum.dur / 60, d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$med.flow,     d = 1),
    med_iqr(df$pct.tube2,    d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$pct.lap2,     d = 0),
    n_pct(df$water.trap),
    med_iqr(df$weight.gain,                  d = 0),
    med_iqr(df$proportional.recaptured.sevo, d = 0)
)

row_labels <- c(
    "",
    "Cases per canister",
    "Inhalational anaesthesia, %",
    "TIVA, %",
    "Total anaesthesia duration, h",
    "Median fresh gas flow, l.min⁻¹",
    "Tracheal tube, %",
    "Laparoscopic surgery, %",
    "Water trap, n (%)",
    "Weight gain, g",
    "Estimated recaptured sevoflurane, g"
)

t1_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(grp_dfs, make_col))
t1_df  <- data.frame(Variable = row_labels, t1_mat,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(
    t1_df,
    col.names = c("", names(grp_dfs)),
    row.names = FALSE,
    caption   = paste0(
        "Characteristics of the ", n_agcs["final"], " analysed canisters, ",
        "overall and by centre. ",
        "Continuous variables: Median [Q1–Q3]; water trap: n (%). ",
        "Interquartile ranges are given for centres with at least five canisters. ",
        "Fresh gas flow is the duration-weighted median across each canister’s cases. ",
        "Percentages are medians across canisters and therefore do not sum to 100%. "
    )
)
```

```{r weight-gain-stripplot-by-centre, echo = FALSE, dev = ifelse_is_docx("tiff", "png"), fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, fig.cap = paste0('Weight gain (in vivo mass transfer, ΔW₀) by participating centre for all ', n_agcs['final'], ' analysed canisters, centres ordered by their median weight gain. Each point represents one canister; diamonds denote canisters equipped with a water trap, circles those without. Short vertical lines mark each centre’s median weight gain. The dashed vertical line marks the overall median weight gain.')}
wg_data_strip <- agcs[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason), ]

ctr_lvls <- sort(unique(wg_data_strip$center))
n_ctr    <- length(ctr_lvls)
ctr_pal  <- setNames(
    grDevices::hcl.colors(n_ctr, palette = "Viridis"),
    ctr_lvls
)

wg_data_strip$center <- factor(wg_data_strip$center, levels = ctr_lvls)

wg_list <- split(wg_data_strip$weight.gain, wg_data_strip$center)
wt_list <- split(wg_data_strip$water.trap,  wg_data_strip$center)

ctr_order <- rev(order(sapply(wg_list, median)))
op <- par(mar = c(5, 4.5, 4, 1))

plot(
    NULL,
    ylim = c(0.5, n_ctr + 0.5),
    xlim = grDevices::extendrange(wg_data_strip$weight.gain, f = 0.04),
    xaxt = "n",
    yaxt = "n",
    ylab = "",
    xlab = "",
    bty  = "n"
)
abline(h = seq_len(n_ctr), col = "grey85", lwd = 1)

for (i in seq_len(n_ctr)) {
    idx  <- ctr_order[i]
    wg_i <- wg_list[[idx]]
    wt_i <- wt_list[[idx]]

    ## draw "no water trap" first, "water trap" last so it is never hidden
    ## underneath an overlapping point at (almost) the same weight gain
    if (any(wt_i == 0L)) {
        stripchart(
            wg_i[wt_i == 0L],
            at = i, add = TRUE, vertical = FALSE,
            pch = 21L, col = ctr_pal[i],
            bg  = adjustcolor(ctr_pal[i], alpha.f = 0.5)
        )
    }
    if (any(wt_i == 1L)) {
        stripchart(
            wg_i[wt_i == 1L],
            at = i, add = TRUE, vertical = FALSE,
            pch = 23L, col = ctr_pal[i],
            bg  = adjustcolor(ctr_pal[i], alpha.f = 0.5)
        )
    }
    segments(
        median(wg_i), i - 0.25,
        median(wg_i), i + 0.25,
        col = "black", lwd = 2
    )
}
med_all <- median(wg_data_strip$weight.gain)
abline(v = med_all, lty = 2, col = col_ref)
text(
    med_all, n_ctr + 0.5,
    labels = paste0("Overall median: ", round(med_all, 0), " g"),
    pos = 4, cex = 0.7, col = col_ref
)

legend("topleft", inset = c(0, -0.11), xpd = TRUE, horiz = TRUE,
       legend = c("Water trap", "No water trap"),
       pch    = c(23L, 21L),
       col    = col_ref,
       pt.bg  = adjustcolor(col_ref, alpha.f = 0.5),
       bty    = "n",
       cex    = leg_cex,
       text.col = "#808080")
title(main = "WEIGHT GAIN BY PARTICIPATING CENTRE", col.main = "#808080", adj = 0L, line = 2.2)
title(xlab = "WEIGHT GAIN [g]", adj = 0L, col.lab = "#808080")
title(ylab = "CENTRE", adj = 1L, col.lab = "#808080")
axis(1L, col = "#808080", col.axis = "#808080", lwd.ticks = 0, at = seq(0, 500, by = 100), labels = c(0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500))
axis(2L, col = NA, col.axis = "#808080", lwd.ticks = 0, las = 2, at = seq_len(n_ctr), labels = ctr_lvls[ctr_order])

par(op)
```
